name: Decoupled Passkeys
description: Adds passkey (WebAuthn) authentication support for decoupled front-ends, via JSON-RPC and the WebAuthn framework.
project_description:
Experimental module to add support for using passkeys to login to Drupal 10. Uses JSON:RPC and version 4 of webauthn-lib.

 Features 
 Adds JSON:RPC endpoints for allowing users to register/login with Webauthn in a decoupled setting.

 Currently in an experimental stage; custom code will be required.

 Post-Installation 
 Check the README for details.

 Similar projects 
 
 Webauthn Authenticator : Drupal 8/9 module with support for coupled Webauthn 
 Webauthn : Dev only module with support for coupled webauthn 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 All contributions are welcome. Please submit MRs, not patches, so that the CI tests are run. Please add tests if possible.

 If you post an issue and do not receive a response, feel free to contact me by private message in the Drupal Slack (ptmkenny) or via my Drupal.org contact form .
